overview: The Medford Commission for Persons with Disabilities reviewed administrative guidelines, voted to adjust its holiday meeting calendar, discussed website and communication accessibility concerns, and prioritized local intersections for a pedestrian signal accessibility grant.

items.title: Welcome, Administrative Updates, and Holiday Meeting Calendar
items.summary: The Commission welcomed attendees, reviewed administrative expectations, and voted to hold a combined November/December meeting on December 9, 2026.

items.title: IHCD Survey and Digital Accessibility Concerns
items.summary: The Commission received updates on the Institute for Human Centered Design (IHCD) surveys of municipal structures and sidewalks, and discussed concerns regarding the accessibility of IHCD's digital communications.

items.title: Pedestrian Signal Grant and Intersection Prioritization
items.summary: The Commission reviewed a list of candidate intersections presented by Traffic Director Todd Blake to prioritize for upgrades with ADA-compliant audible pedestrian signals funded by a casino mitigation grant.

items.title: Approval of June Minutes
items.summary: The Commission approved the meeting minutes from June 2026.

items.title: Announcements and Community Events
items.summary: The Commission discussed several upcoming community events, including Fire Prevention Day and Hispanic Heritage Month, and raised questions regarding accessibility features for Run Medford.
